notes.title: Today the console version of “Snezinka” is released!
notes.notes:
Snezhinka, the sequel to Marfusha, will release on the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S on February 13.

https://playism.com/en/game/snezhinka/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796011/0326f6b150a2f421f32750f9f4f78a53eb7565d4.png[/img]

It is thanks to all of you who played the Steam version that a small game produced by an individual was able to be distributed on three different platforms.

Thank you very much!
We look forward to your continued support for this series.

notes.title: Added the ability to change background music
notes.notes:
A BGM change function has been added to the game for the Challenge Mode.
The BGM can be changed during the Challenge Mode from the lower right corner of the character selection screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796011/cd5aadfdf016d8a8a300b746605b1cbfb189182d.png[/img]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that caused enemies after 90 days of True Route to roll over after being destroyed.
Fixed typos in in-game text.

notes.title: Balance adjustment update
notes.notes:
The appearance rate of the card “Companion LvUP” has been increased.
Slightly increased the appearance rate of multi-barreled rifles when using Snezinka.
The rate of increase in attack power of submachine guns when using Krasavka has been increased.

notes.title: Game balance adjustment update
notes.notes:
The movement speed of submachine gun species and the movement speed while aiming have been increased.
The magazine capacity of submachine gun B has been increased.
The power and the number of loaded rounds of the advanced submachine gun A have been increased.
The power of the advanced submachine gun B has been increased.
The daily recovery amount of Anita's ability has been increased.
The behavior of the Challenge Mode bosses has been adjusted.
Minor bugs have been fixed.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem in which progress was reset when the ending was viewed from the recollection screen while the main mode was interrupted.
Fixed a problem in which using a strong-loaded bullet while using a strong-loaded bullet would not return to normal ammunition.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug in which localized text was garbled.
Fixed a bug in which the effect of automatic recovery was not reflected in the final stage of the main mode.
Other minor bugs have been fixed.
Adjusted the balance of the enemy pop when surviving more than 200 days in the challenge mode.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem in which the green gadget could be used infinitely when used at the moment of scene change.
The starting position of long-range attack type enemies has been fine-tuned.

notes.title: Game specification changes & bug fixes
notes.notes:
When selecting Krasavka's ability in the main mode, a sparkling effect now appears while the ability is increasing.
The formula for calculating the influence of bonus cards that change the speed of enemies has been changed.
Fixed a problem in which the gun would disappear if the green gadget or grenade was quickly entered using the QE key.
Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed display corruption in localization.
Fixed a bug that caused inoperability in extremely rare cases when the game was over in the dark after the end of main mode combat.
Fixed other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Added save data restore function to the game.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796011/be05c2e79c5e3cf78a3adc8b648e4d76e395abd7.png[/img]
Added the ability to recover saved data.

When save data corruption is detected immediately after game startup,
The data recovery screen is now available to restore the data of the ending recovery status and gun collection status.

Corruption detection is based on the data reported so far,
I am aware that there may be unexpected cases in the future.
In such cases, corruption cannot be detected,

In this case, please contact the author from the official website.
https://snezhinka.ltt.jp/en/index.html

If you find it troublesome to email the author, please delete the saved data stored in the following paths.

C:\Users\<USERNAME>\AppData\LocalLow\hinyari9\Snezhinka

However, please note that deleting this data will initialize all game 

If you cannot find it with the above information, please enter the following path from windows explorer.
%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\hinyari9\Snezhinka

hinyari9

notes.title: Balance Adjustment Update
notes.notes:
The following changes have been made to Abrek's abilities.
Before: “When an enemy is killed, the blue gadget's cool time is reduced by 1
After: “When an enemy is killed by an attack other than the blue gadget, the blue gadget's cool time is reduced by 1

The increased rate of fire of Lisichka's sniper rifle has been slightly reduced.

The pushback power of Sniper Rifle B has been adjusted.

Flamethrower flames now penetrate enemy defenses.

Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem in which the bonus card weight tax would result in a negative amount of money in one's possession.
Fixed a problem in which some cards would have a negative value when the bonus card “Half Price Sale” was in effect and Anita was used.
Fixed an issue where the blue gadget grenade would not return to the gun in rare cases if the gadget was continuously thrown while the chance card “Blue Gadget Cool Time Reduction” was in effect.
Fixed an issue where the gun would automatically fire the remaining ammunition after reloading when running out of ammunition while burst firing.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem in which the durability did not increase when the Assault Rifle B was obtained consecutively.
Fixed a problem in which the advanced grenade launcher B did not receive an endurance bonus when using Dochka.
The behavior of shields in the firing range has been adjusted.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that prevented the release of the “Memoirs of a Friendless Player”.
Fixed a problem in which some chance cards were not reflected correctly in the challenge mode.
Fixed a typo in a conversation.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem in which the effect of the bonus card “2 Card” became permanent.
The behavior of the controller has been changed so that it does not automatically switch to controller operation once it has been switched to mouse operation while the controller is still present.
Fixed a problem in which the button selection on the reminiscence screen would not work when using a controller.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that caused the True Route to rarely reach 102 days or more.
Fixed a problem that occurred when changing guns at the shooting range while the timer was running.
Fixed a typographical error.
Fixed a problem in which the second page of Datica was not unlocked correctly in the Story Mode.
I will continue to fix bugs that have been reported to me.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
The following problems have been fixed
Fixed a problem in which cards could not be selected with Datica's ability after True Stage 4.
Fixed a typo in some conversations.
Fixed a problem in which the speaker and the dialogue in a conversation did not match.
Fixed a problem in which users could get achievements with zero retries when they checked the epilogue.

I will continue to fix the problems.

notes.title: Snezhinka: Sentinel Girls 2 Releases on August 27 !
notes.notes:
Marfusha sequel Snezhinka: Sentinel Girls 2 will launch on August 27 !
The new high-tempo shooter will cost $7.99 and feature English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, and Japanese text support. 

I have also released a website where you can learn about the characters.
Of course, it supports multiple languages.

Web site
https://snezhinka.ltt.jp/en/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796011/1ccbc16e7b7215b8d98af6bc800bd584ea5aef31.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer's Note Electrothermal Cannon
notes.notes:
A disposable weapon that burns down all enemies in the game, including the last boss, with a single blow.
It appears only in "certain stages" in the main mode.
In the Challenge Mode, it can be purchased when using Snezhinka.
[previewyoutube=8ljn_yJqjks;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Developer's Note Squad Tactics Card
notes.notes:
The coworker will move from in front of the defensive target to follow the player.
The speed of movement depends on the type and level of the companions.
[previewyoutube=1t-3Z7qE4T8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Developer's Note Tank
notes.notes:
I made a tank in my game.
While marching together, they automatically intercept the enemy using the tank gun and machine gun.
You can replace the tank gun with another type by purchasing it from the card.
[previewyoutube=hqTVNtW1a2I;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Developer's Note Shooting Range
notes.notes:
I created a "shooting range."
You can try out your guns and compete for shooting scores.
There is a colleague who is very proud of being the number one shooter,
You can try your best to destroy her pride and self-esteem.
[previewyoutube=n45bxS8ut-M;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Developer's Note Bounding mine
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=BSdAlYRoXe4;full][/previewyoutube]
When an enemy steps on it, it jumps up and sprays attacks all around.
Once placed, it can be triggered multiple times.
The mines were not easy to use in the previous work, so they are being improved.
Other types of mines are also available.

notes.title: Developer's Note Animation of Snezinka's colleagues
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=xtlg2o5ooVM;full][/previewyoutube]


I am increasing the number of animation patterns, whereas the last one was one per person.

It is very easy to add more animation patterns as it only costs me sleep and my wrists!
Currently I have drawn 859 pictures in the company housing alone, there may be more.

In all seriousness, the user who plays will only interact with 1 or 2 characters at most.
Having multiple animation patterns for all characters is a very poor cost-effective choice.
However, I really wanted to draw it, so I did.

notes.title: Developer's Note New Card Over time request.
notes.notes:
Requests for "paid work" that are not approved.
Overtime work requests" that are approved in a blink of an eye.
[previewyoutube=Wsqsm4B8eO0;full][/previewyoutube]
The "Apply for Overtime" card, in exchange for more rewards, forces players to fight very hard until the day they can take a day off at the company housing.
Players must use good judgment to decide whether to get more rewards or play it safe.
